title: Team activity by repo
description: Which repos each team is active in — type a team or repo to filter. This is a team-wide rollup (headcount + totals per repo); for a named maintainer's own by-repo activity, see the 'Roles and recent activity by repo' table, and for individual TSC members, see the TSC table.

columns.label: members active
columns.description: The number of active team members in the selected period.

columns.label: PRs
columns.description: Pull requests opened by active team members in the selected period.

columns.label: reviews
columns.description: Pull request reviews submitted by active team members in the selected period.

columns.label: merges
columns.description: Pull requests merged by active team members in the selected period.

columns.label: issues
columns.description: Issues opened by active team members in the selected period.

columns.label: labels
columns.description: Labels applied by active team members in the selected period.

columns.label: last active
columns.description: The most recent date this team had activity in the selected period.
